g.text: Keep the failure as an unclear result

g.text: Compare the message with records using Qwen

g.title: route_result
g.text: Is the checked result clear or unclear?

g.title: clear_result
g.text: Pass the checked sewing-risk answer to the report

g.title: supervisor_hold
g.text: Pass missing facts to the report; no task is sent

g.title: relevant_message
g.text: Is this a relevant factory update?

g.title: explicit_po
g.text: Does the message identify one PO?

g.title: ignore_message
g.text: No response and no PO report

g.title: recent_three
g.text: Same factory and conversation, before this message

g.title: context_po
g.text: Exactly one PO in those messages
and a clear continuation of that discussion?

g.title: inherit_po
g.text: Use that PO and record its source
Never replace an explicit or conflicting PO
